clustered_profit.description: values concentrate in a few profit bands while weights vary

inverse_correlated.description: lighter items tend to carry larger values

spanner.description: items are scaled variants of a small set of base types

strongly_correlated.description: item values track weights closely with a fixed premium

uncorrelated.description: item values and weights are independent

weakly_correlated.description: item values are noisy but positively related to weights
